trial_court: 1st Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, case no.729/2019
case_name: Hon'Ble R.C. Khulbe vs Chaudhary And Others
facts_of_case: Complainant filed a complaint under Section 406 IPC. After recording evidence, the trial court summoned the applicants. A compromise was reached between the parties.

legal_principles.principle: When a compromise takes place between parties, the criminal proceedings can be quashed.
legal_principles.held: Since, the compromise has taken place between the parties, and accordingly a joint petition under Section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act, 1958 has been moved by the parties before the Family Court, Roorkee

legal_principles.principle: A joint petition under Section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act, 1958 can be filed by parties after a compromise.
legal_principles.held: Apart from that, as per the compromise, the parties have filed a divorce petition under Section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act, 1958

outcome.final_order: The impugned summoning order and entire proceedings were quashed. The parties agreed to file a divorce petition under Section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act, 1958.

use_for_drafting: drafting a quashing petition under Section 482 Cr.PC
preparing a complaint case under Section 406 IPC
advising on the summoning order of a magistrate
